निम्न अधोभूमि उत्पादित सब्जियों में से कौन-सी एक रूपान्तरित जड़ है?

Explanation: The main function of the roots is to keep the plant stable in the soil. And water and mineral salts have to be absorbed from the soil. In some plants, roots are modified for different functions. The transformation of roots is mainly divided into two parts - (a) Transformation of taproots. Due to storage of food, the roots swell and become thick. The transformations of the tap root are of the following types: (1) Taproot root: It becomes thick in the middle and becomes thin at both the ends respectively. From this, small secondary roots emerge which perform the function of absorption. Example- Radish (2) Conical root: Due to accumulation of food, the root becomes thick towards the top and thin towards the bottom. Due to this the shape of the root becomes conical. Secondary roots emerge from the primary root and perform the function of absorption. Example - Carrot (3) Kumbhiriform root - In this, the part between the base and the top (hypocotyl) swells like a pumpkin but the lower part suddenly becomes thin. Secondary roots emerge from the lower part. Example- Turnip, beetroot etc. (b) Transformation of adventitious roots – These are plants except radicle.Develop from other parts of the world. It does not go very deep. Adventitious roots are classified as follows - (a) Food storing roots (1) Tapil roots emerge from the joints of the stem and swell irregularly due to food accumulation. Adventitious buds are found on taproots. These help in reproduction. Example-Sweet Potato (2) Pulkit or tuberous roots: These emerge from the base of the main stem in a group and swell and form tubers. Adventitious roots are found on these. Like- Satavar, Telia etc. (3) Nodular roots: The end ends of this type of roots swell due to food accumulation like ama turmeric.

question:
Which of the following has a pH of about 10? 
निम्नलिखित में से किसका ज्प् लगभग10 होता है?
options: Gastric juice / जठर रस
Blood / रक्त
Milk of magnesia / मैग्नीशिया का दूध
Sodium chloride solution / सोडियम क्लोराइड का विलयन

solution:

Explanation: The pH of milk of magnesia is approximately 10. pH is a measure of the acidity or alkalinity of a solution. The concept of pH was first introduced by Søren Peder Lauritz Sørensen in 1909. Solutions with pH less than 7 are called acidic and solutions with pH greater than 7 are called alkaline. Pure water is considered neutral.

question: Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.I told him that if he went around the park he would see some rare flowers.

question:
…………………had scaled the 8,848-metre peak of Mount Everest and became the youngest mountaineer from Haryana.
…………………ने मांउट एवरेस्ट की 8,848 मीटर की चोटी की चढ़ाई की थी और हरियाणा से सबसे युवा पर्वतारोही बने थे।
options: Narendra yadav / नारेन्द्र यादव
Anita kundoo / अनिता कुंडू
Santosh Yadav / संतोष यादव
Virendra Singh / वीरेन्द्र सिंह
Question Not Attempted   / अनुत्तरित प्रश्न
solution: प्रश्नकाल के दौरान नारेन्द्र यादव माउंट एवरेस्ट की 8,848मी की चोटी पर चढ़कर (वर्ष 2016) हरियाणा के सबसे युवा पर्वतारोही बने थे। तत्कालीन समय में उनकी आयु 19 वर्ष थी। वर्ष 2018 में हरियाणा की शिवांगी पाठक ने 16 वर्ष की आयु में दुनिया की सबसे ऊँची चोटी माउंट एवरेस्ट पर चढ़ाई की। ऐसा करने वाली वह भारत की सबसे युवा महिला बन गई हैं।During the Question Hour, Narendra Yadav became the youngest mountaineer of Haryana (year 2016) by climbing the 8,848 m peak of Mount Everest. He was 19 years old at that time. In the year 2018, Shivangi Pathak of Haryana climbed the world's highest peak Mount Everest at the age of 16. She has become the youngest woman of India to do so.

options: Morni Hills / मोरनी पहाड़ियाँ
mewat hills / मेवात पहाड़ियों
tipra hills / तिपरा पहाड़ियाँ

Question Not Attempted   / अनुत्तरित प्रश्न
solution: भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिम भाग में स्थिति अरावली श्रृंखला विश्व की सबसे पुरानी वलित पर्वत प्रणालियों में में से एक है और अपने वर्तमान स्वरूप में यह अवशिष्ट पहाड़ियों में सिमट गई है। विष्णु पुराण में इसे सुमेरू पर्वत/मेरू पर्वत/परिपत्र पर्वत कहा गया है। अरावली पर्वतमाला के दक्षिणी हिस्से को स्थानीय रूप से 'मेवात पहाड़ियाँ' के नाम से जाना जाता है।The Aravalli range situated in the north-western part of India is one of the oldest folded mountain systems in the world and in its present form it has been reduced to residual hills. In Vishnu Purana it has been called Sumeru Parvat/Meru Parvat/Parikripaar Parvat. The southern part of the Aravalli mountain range is locally known as 'Mewat Hills'.

question:
Which Chief Minister of Haryana became the Deputy Prime Minister?
हरियाणा के कौन से मुख्यमंत्री उप प्रधानमंत्री बने?
options: Bansi Lal / बंसी लाल
Devi Lal / देवी लाल
Bhajanlal / भजन लाल
Hukum Singh / हुकुम सिंह
Question Not Attempted   / अनुत्तरित प्रश्न
solution: चौधरी देवी लाल, हरियाणा राज्य के दो बार मुख्यमंत्री (1977 से 1979 व 1987 से 1989 तक) रहे। ये अक्टूबर, 1989 से 21 जून, 1991 तक भारत के उप प्रधानमंत्री रहे। ये हरियाणा में "ताऊ देवी लाल" के नाम से भी प्रसिद्ध थे। इनकी समाधि "संघर्ष घाट" दिल्ली में निर्मित है।Chaudhary Devi Lal was the Chief Minister of Haryana state twice (from 1977 to 1979 and from 1987 to 1989). He was the Deputy Prime Minister of India from October 1989 to 21 June 1991. He was also famous as "Tau Devi Lal" in Haryana. His Samadhi "Sangharsh Ghat" is built in Delhi.
